props.heading: Play before you buy
props.body: Four tables at the back, a library of 300 titles, no charge. Ask at the counter and we will teach you the rules.

props.heading: Complexity, not hype
props.body: Every listing carries players, playtime and a complexity rating from 1 to 5, because those three numbers decide whether a game fits your evening.

props.heading: We say when it is out
props.body: A reprint pending means the publisher has confirmed one. Out of print means we cannot get it, and we will tell you who might.

props.heading: About Baize
paragraphs: We opened in 2019 with eleven games and one table. The shop is named for the cloth on that table, which is still there and now has a scorch mark from a tea light.
Everything listed here is on the shelf in Gothenburg unless it says otherwise. Stock is read live, so what you see is what is in the building.
